exposure: Level I, II, and III neonatal care units
cohort: 2322 infants (4644 ears) with delivery records who underwent NHS between 2004 and 2017
finding: The referral rate for newborn hearing screening was significantly higher in infants born via cesarean delivery than vaginal delivery in Level I and II neonatal care units, particularly when the screening was performed within 72 hours of birth using AABR.
mod_finding: The referral rate for newborn hearing screening was significantly higher in infants born via cesarean delivery than vaginal delivery in Level I and II neonatal care units, particularly when the screening was performed within 72 hours of birth using AABR.
